race.comment: LETTERS PATENT (5) bounced off his solid debut third to Omolong in town, with a decisive on-pace victory over 1200m at Newcastle in Soft (7) going with the 58kg. Key jockey change and stalks the speed. Sure to measure up again. HALF PIPE (9) spelled after having no luck from the gate on debut last December. Heavily supported on resumption with a commanding 3-len maiden win over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Has further upside and can get cover from the draw. SCINTILLATION (3) resumes. Returned good figures when winning on debut at Gosford last February. Then thrown in the deep end with a gritty on-speed third over 1000m at Flemington in the G3 Ottawa last March. Trialled well and gets every chance from the low gate. ICED FURY (12) slick debut winner at Wyong and deserves her chance here.
